create.name: Lisa Whatley
create.bio:
Lisa Whatley is an Ontario-based energy healer and meditation guide who has worked with clients for more than twenty-five years. Her practice draws on Reiki, chakra and aura clearing, cord cutting and work with the Violet Flame, and she describes her sessions as infusions of high-frequency light. She writes for people she sees as sensitive or newly awakening: empaths, lightworkers and self-healers looking for a gentler relationship with their own energy.

Most people meet her through her recorded meditations, which she voices herself and releases each week on YouTube and Insight Timer, with new and full moon rituals, morning resets, manifestation practices and long relaxation journeys. Through her site, The Healing Corridor, she offers short distant energy sessions for clearing and protection, a thirty-day introduction to daily meditation for beginners and a teaching on shifting your identity around money. She also takes private distant sessions, a limited number of in-person sessions at her studio, and commissions for personalised meditation scripts. Free material includes a gentle email series for days when you feel out of sorts and a new moon practice for choosing a fresh direction.

flags: Tier borderline: ~94.9k total, just under the 100k luminary line.

Much of her Insight Timer and YouTube catalogue is titled for sleep, anxiety, pain, migraine, nervous system and 'physical healing'; only clearly non-condition items were kept. A reviewer may judge the overall brand too condition-led.
Heavy marketing on her sales pages (countdown 'today only' prices, donation tiers up to $100,000 on the Expansion page, 'remove destructive implants / death seals' programmes); those items left out.

No about page or training details found; bio facts (25+ years, Reiki, Violet Flame, Ontario) come from her sales pages and Insight Timer. No city given, so availability set to worldwide although she mentions in-person studio sessions.
Prices on her pages show '$' without a currency; USD assumed because her Angelic Light page states USD.

Instagram @lisa_whatley and Facebook lisawhatleyhealing are not linked from her site; they match her name, Amazon shop handle (lisa_whatley) and branding, so treated as hers. A separate empty @lisawhatley Instagram was ignored.
WebFetch quoted only two short lines of her Insight Timer bio.
